title: Optional machine cell
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, let a machine cell be a cell value of $N$ when present, and otherwise absent; thus the type of optional machine cells is the option type of the cell values of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
caveat: The statement refers to `CellV N`, whose definition and informal description are not included, so its contents cannot be described more specifically.
